verification_script:
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
manifest=Path('docs/deployment/evidence/SD-PERSONA-CYCLE-RECONNECT-20261112/evidence.json')
e=json.loads(manifest.read_text());p=Path(e['document']);s=p.read_text();base=e['repo_base']
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','461e458c8a16a0a5163a1f32651c5f046688ce7e:'+str(p)],text=True)
quotes=lambda text: re.findall(r'^> (.*)$',text,re.M)
assert quotes(s)==quotes(original)==e['operator_statements_2026_11_12'], 'operator quotes changed'
assert e['hosted_behavior_claimed'] is False
assert e['hosted_observation_provenance']['independently_reverified'] is False
section=s.split('\n## 2.')[1].split('\n## 4.')[0]
refs=[]
for token in re.findall(r'`([^`]+)`',section):
    m=re.fullmatch(r'([^:]+\.(?:md|py|json))(?::(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?)?',token)
    assert not token.startswith(':'), f'shorthand reference: {token}'
    if not m: continue
    path,start,end=m.groups(); source=Path(path)
    assert source.is_file(), f'missing {token}'
    delivered=source.read_bytes();baseline=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+path])
    assert delivered==baseline, f'reference changed from checked base: {path}'
    lines=delivered.decode().splitlines()
    if start: assert 1<=int(start)<=int(end or start)<=len(lines), f'bad line {token}'
    refs.append({'reference':token,'base_blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',base+':'+path],text=True).strip()})
assert refs
refs=list({r['reference']:r for r in refs}.values())
assert refs==e['source_verification']['citations'], 'citation manifest differs'
decisions=s.split('\n## 4.')[1].split('\n## 5.')[0]
rows=re.findall(r'^\| D(\d+) \| (.*)$',decisions,re.M)
assert [int(n) for n,_ in rows]==list(range(1,14))
for n,row in rows:
    assert re.search(r'`[^`]+\.(md|py|json)(?::[^`]*)?`',row), f'D{n} missing source'
allowed={str(p),str(manifest)}
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed==allowed, f'out-of-scope change: {changed}'
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check',base],check=True)
print(f'PASS: {len(refs)} citations resolve at {base}; 7 verbatim statements; D1-D13 cite sources; exact two-file scope; JSON false hosted claim; diff whitespace clean')
